descriptions.text: Mountains of chassis. A crushed ambulance. The paths are goat-tracks of mud and oil. West returns to the market. East, a bus full of medicine. North, glass that grew like fruit.

The yard feels larger without the red lens circling it. The drone is a sparking bowl in the mud. West, market. East, the clinic. North, the orchard. If the chassis hid anything, it is hiding worse now.
